ModelMetadata.Author: SchoolPulse Portfolio Project
ModelMetadata.Description: NoSQL Workbench model for the SchoolPulse Version 2 student event log. Aligned with the 216 student SchoolPulsePortfolio database and the completed Python analytics pipeline. Stores risk alerts, attendance concerns, teacher interventions, parent notifications, score activity, support requests, reviews, status changes, and positive performance events.
